medium_statement: Loose pastel ink-and-wash storybook illustration of a pastel sunset beach: soft flat-to-gently-graded colour fields under a thin, slightly wobbly dark-brown ink line, with scattered white spatter dots for sea spray and sparkle.
line: Thin, sketchy dark-brown ink outline that wobbles and occasionally breaks, drawn around clouds, foam, pebbles and petals; loose contour hatching only on pebbles and cloud bellies, never heavy or fully uniform.

fill.description: Soft translucent pastel washes with gentle edge-to-edge gradients (sky, sea, wet sand) and a little pooling at cloud and foam edges; foam and sand highlights are left as near-white paper with sparse white spatter on top.

texture: Smooth matte paper surface with almost no grain; texture comes only from the wobbling ink line and scattered white spatter dots, not from pigment granulation.

palette.role: peach-pink sunset glow and cloud undersides
warm grey wet-sand and pebble shading
near-white paper foam, dry sand and cloud highlights
taupe pebble mid-tone and dune grass shadow
dusty rose cloud shadow and frangipani petal
sea-glass teal of the shallow wave
dark brown ink line and pebble core

forbidden: visible pigment granulation or canvas grain
crisp flat vector fill with no gradient
notes: Pinterest sunset-beach reference (artist signature 'EKA SAKTY' visible top-left — never to be reproduced). Probe run for the ComfyUI/klein backend, WEDDING, Stage family (B), PRO.
